name: komdosh-dev-spring-qa
description: End-to-end QA artifact generation on top of komdosh-dev-spring-core. Three commands (/qa-plan, /qa-postman, /qa-console) backed by three agents that share a single discover-api-surface skill (OpenAPI file → Springdoc runtime if hinted → static controller parse). Outputs: a manual validation plan, a Newman-runnable Postman collection, and a self-contained HTML QA console. Plus one PostToolUse hook that warns when the plan goes stale relative to controller mtimes. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
